title: Chapter 251
text:
No pop-up window, free to read!

A genius will remember "Love Go Go Small" in one second. "Talk → Net", providing you with interesting novels to read.

In the car, Han Xiao smoked a cigarette as he repaired his mechanical suit. At the same time, he opened the players' forum. The Germinal Organization player that he had just killed had posted a post.

"Mission target discovered, Han Xiao's coordinates are …"

"The Germinal Organization has released a new tracking mission. Eight missing two requesting to form a team. Location: Ossen Fort. Depart in twenty minutes."

Upon seeing this, Han Xiao chuckled.

The Germinal Organization players also participated in the tracking mission. As the mission requirement was only to discover his tracks, it would not lower their favorability with him, so the players accepted the mission without worry.

Although Han Xiao had not given any benefits to the Germinal Organization players so far, with the players from the other three continents as examples, the Germinal Organization players still loved him.

Ever since Han Xiao's identity was exposed, the players were very enthusiastic about him and actively participated in missions related to Han Xiao. However, they had no other choice. The Germinal Organization's current strategic focus was completely on him. Basically, all of their missions revolved around hunting down Han Xiao.

Logically speaking, an enemy that could be resurrected should cause a lot of trouble, but Han Xiao was glad that the players participated in the pursuit.

In addition to tracking, the Germinal Organization also estimated his location based on the tracks and set up an encirclement in advance. However, Han Xiao would always break through a weak defense gap before the encirclement was fully formed. This was not a coincidence.

The posts shared by the Germinal Organization players on the forums were his source of information!

The players did not know that an 'NPC' could see their forums, and the Germinal Organization did not know about the existence of the forums, so Han Xiao was in the middle.

He pieced together the movement of the Germinal Organization's troops from the information on the forums and saw through the Germinal Organization's deployment, but the Germinal Organization did not know where the information was leaked from!

The Germinal Organization did not know that this time, they had been tricked by their own 'inhuman', and the leader had no doubt that Han Xiao had the ability to foresee the future.

Han Xiao was not worried that the Germinal Organization players would not post anything. Recently, his popularity had been extremely high. He had almost dominated the Blue Star section, and the players showed great enthusiasm for him.

He had revealed his true face. Compared to his original middle-aged salted fish uncle face, it was like the line between heaven and hell. Han Xiao successfully harvested the first wave of fangirls. Under the hot post that revealed his identity, there were a bunch of shocked replies such as "What the f * ck, who are you, handsome?" and "There's no harm without comparison!" There were also a bunch of kisses and love from female players.

A behind-the-scenes, boss-like character turned out to be a fresh young man. This contrast was especially easy to win the hearts of female players. Han Xiao finally enjoyed the treatment of having female fans. One had to know that when he was still Black Phantom, those who chased after him were all a bunch of nerds …

However, the enthusiasm of the players was beyond his expectations. After the initial shock, the direction of the players' discussion gradually became strange.

The Germinal Organization players took screenshots of his escape and shared them on the forum. When the players saw that he had a big girl, a small girl, a mature woman, and a loli with him, they instantly exploded.

Why did he have to escape with two women? Needless to say, this had to be love!

Therefore, a player with a crazy imagination came up with a love story in his head.

"I was once a test subject, and I experienced inhuman torment. And in that abysmal darkness, she was the only light. Every time I saw her tall figure and cold face, the torment inflicted on me seemed to no longer be painful. Although I was only a lowly test subject, and she never smiled at me, her angry rebuke and cold eyes made me feel the warmth of spring. Could it be … this is the feeling of love? So I secretly swore that if one day I could escape and become a big shot, I would definitely stand in front of her and use the most affectionate tone to tell her, 'I love you' … "

When he saw this post, Han Xiao spat out the energy drink in his mouth onto Hella.

Which perverted masochist wrote this! Which rock did you jump out from, you drama queen!?

Don't let me see you outside! I'll kill you back to level 0!

This was only one of the versions. Some people imagined that Han Xiao and the red-haired mature woman fell in love at first sight, so the mature woman gave up her faith and eloped with him, taking a little girl with them!
